page_title: CRY 0-3 MCI | Crystal Palace v Manchester City 14/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Rayan Ait Nouri (Manchester City) is replacing Nico O'Reilly.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Omar Marmoush (Manchester City) is coming onto the pitch as Erling Haaland cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Pep Guardiola decides to make a substitution. Bernardo Silva will be replaced by Rico Lewis (Manchester City).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' That was close by Phil Foden (Manchester City)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
89' 0 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Erling Haaland (Manchester City) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Dean Henderson no chance!
89' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
88' Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Darren England signals. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Manchester City.
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Tijjani Reijnders will be replaced by Savinho (Manchester City).
85' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.
81' This shall not pass! Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
77' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Nathaniel Clyne is replaced by Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace).
69' 0 - 2 Goal! Phil Foden (Manchester City) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
68' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
67' Oliver Glasner is forced to make a change. Daichi Kamada is unable to continue due to injury, Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) comes on.
65' Nico (Manchester City) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) for Jean-Philippe Mateta.
62' Darren England shows a yellow card to Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
59' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
59' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
56' A brilliant cross into the box finds Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City), who directs his low header onto the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
56' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) was too forceful with his tackle and Darren England interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

55' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
55' Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' The Manchester City players are exchanging some short passes.
51' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
49' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the right post and wastes a promising chance!
48' Crystal Palace are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
47' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a save.
44' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
41' 0 - 1 Erling Haaland (Manchester City) jumps for a cross and plants a precise header low inside the right post.
38' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Darren England blows for a foul.
37' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
35' Darren England blows his whistle after Nico (Manchester City) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
33' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
33' A clumsy foul by Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) and Darren England blows his whistle.
30' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Tijjani Reijnders (Manchester City) heads on.
30' Phil Foden (Manchester City) misses a promising chance to score from the free kick, but Dean Henderson makes a decent save.
28' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
27' Good movement by Nico O'Reilly (Manchester City), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
25' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
24' A pass by Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
23' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:1.
20' A pass by Phil Foden (Manchester City) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

18' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Darren England blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
17' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the crossbar. Close!
16' A long pass, executed by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
13' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' The ball is cleared after Erling Haaland (Manchester City) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' A rebound falls at the feet of Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
10' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
7' Rayan Cherki (Manchester City) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
4' Great teamplay by Manchester City as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
1' One of the players from Crystal Palace times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Darren England was nominated as the referee for this game.
